blocker_detail: The graph-safe no-DP BatchedMarlin prototype selected BATCHED_MARLIN and BatchedPrepareAndFinalize, and it moved past the earlier illegal host-scalar branch in prepare_finalize/batched.py. It then spent minutes capturing 51 CUDA graph sizes at max_num_batched_tokens=512, made the Spark4 head unresponsive to SSH banner exchange, and never reached API readiness. This path is still not a measured throughput win and should not replace the standard MARLIN lane.
error_signature: Spark4 head stopped accepting SSH banners during FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graph capture; API never reached /v1/models; last captured log showed mixed prefill-decode PIECEWISE CUDA graph capture at 20/51.
interpretation: This prototype removed the first BatchedMarlin startup blocker but exposed that Python-level per-expert packing plus full graph capture is not yet an efficient route. The higher-leverage perf path is unlocking the existing FlashInfer TRTLLM MXFP4 MoE kernel on GB10, then measuring c512 against the 174.190 tok/s standard MARLIN baseline.
required_next_code_change: Keep this profile disabled by default. After Spark4 physical recovery, delete or quarantine any recipe that sets DS4_VLLM_FORCE_NO_DP_BATCHED_MARLIN=1 unless an operator passes --unsafe-allow-spark4-wedge-profile on an isolated expendable node. Do not keep expanding the Python BatchedPrepareAndFinalize adapter as the primary speed path.
